about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Discover Glory Church Of Nanshijiao — our mission, faith, and community
about.mission_text: Through the love of Jesus Christ, to build a faith community that cares for one another, grows together, and brings the Gospel to everyone.
about.vision_intro: We want this to be a place where anyone — with or without a faith background — can find belonging, grow as a person, and make a difference in the community around them.
about.vision_text: To build an apostolic and prophetic church — pastoral in care, missional in strategy — that glorifies God and benefits people. Through discipleship training, we cultivate a healthy, joyful, passionate, and influential church.

about.history_text: Glory Church Of Nanshijiao is part of Glory Church Taipei (行道會台北榮耀堂) and is rooted in the Nanshijiao community of Zhonghe District, New Taipei City. Over the years, our congregation has continued to grow into a vibrant community of faith. We believe every person has unique gifts from God and are committed to helping each member discover and live out God's calling.

first_visit.page_subtitle: No faith background required. No RSVP needed. You're already on your way.
first_visit.intro: Maybe a friend invited you, or you're just curious. Either way, we're glad you're here. Here are the questions we hear most often from first-time visitors.
first_visit.q1_q: Do I need to be a Christian to come?
first_visit.q1_a: Not at all. Everyone is welcome, regardless of faith background. Many first-time visitors come just to see what church is like, or to accompany a friend. That's completely fine.
first_visit.q2_q: Do I need to register in advance?
first_visit.q2_a: No. Just show up on Sunday at 10:00 AM. If you'd like to let us know ahead of time, you're welcome to reach out by phone or contact form — we'll have someone at the door to greet you.
first_visit.q3_q: What will happen during the service?
first_visit.q3_a: The service lasts about 90 minutes: worship songs (~20 min), announcements, and a sermon (~40 min). It's conducted in Mandarin Chinese. You don't need to do anything — sitting quietly is completely fine. There's usually a light refreshment time after, but you're welcome to leave at any point.
first_visit.q4_q: Will it be awkward to come alone?
first_visit.q4_a: We have greeters at the entrance specifically to welcome first-time visitors. No one will ask you to stand up or introduce yourself. A greeter will help you find a seat, and you're welcome to ask them anything. You can be as low-key as you like.
first_visit.q5_a: Yes. Sunday school runs at the same time as the main service and is suitable for preschool to elementary-age children. Parents worship in the main hall while children are cared for by dedicated staff. We recommend arriving 10 minutes early so children can settle in.
first_visit.q6_q: How do I find the entrance?
first_visit.q6_a: The church is at No. 39-15, Zhongxiao St., Zhonghe District, New Taipei City — ground floor entrance with clear signage. From MRT Zhonghe-Xinlu Line Nanshijiao Station (O01), take Exit 4 and walk about 10 minutes (700 m). If you get lost, call (02) 8668-5515.
first_visit.q7_q: Is the church accessible for people with mobility needs?
first_visit.q7_a: The main hall is on the ground floor — no stairs required to enter. If you have specific needs or would like assistance, please call (02) 8668-5515 in advance and we'll arrange a greeter to meet you at the door.
first_visit.cta_sub: Feel free to reach out, or check our service times.
